one_line: An interactive test measuring lip fullness using a research-backed scale with Sydney Sweeney as the visual model.

hook.what_happens: Displays Sydney Sweeney with an overlay asking viewers to measure their lip fullness.
hook.why_it_works: Leverages instant self-assessment curiosity and celebrity familiarity.

shots.description: Continuous portrait shot of Sydney Sweeney with dynamic text, image overlays, and a scientific paper screenshot.
shots.layout: Full-bleed portrait with floating UI cards

devices.name: Lip scale cards
devices.what_it_is: Cropped lip images labeled 1 to 5 representing fullness levels.
devices.used_for: Visual reference for the measurement scale.

devices.name: Research paper overlay
devices.what_it_is: A screenshot of an academic paper on lip fullness grading.

devices.name: Interactive selector box
devices.what_it_is: A white square frame highlighting the subject's lips.
devices.used_for: Simulating an active scanning or measurement process.

onscreen_text.text: Carruthers A, Bogle M, Donofrio L, et al. Lip fullness assessment...

transcript.text: Based on this study, how full are yours?

narrative_arc: Introduce the lip fullness measurement concept
Present scientific backing via academic study

cta.what: Prompting the viewer to determine their own lip fullness level.

what_makes_it_work: Interactive self-assessment format drives high viewer engagement.
Celebrity visual reference increases retention and appeal.

animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Elements slide in from the left or pop in with elastic scaling.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Fading out quietly to clear the frame.

animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The main background portrait of the actress.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Bursty, timed with voiceover cues and key visual reveals.

what_we_should_steal: Horizontal sliding card carousel for step-by-step comparisons
Staggered row reveal for presenting multi-option scales
